name: skills
description: A collection of AI agent skills for working with Expo projects and Expo Application Services
one_liner: A pack of ready-made instructions that teach AI coding assistants how to correctly build and ship mobile apps using Expo.
buyer: Honestly, no standalone paying buyer — this is official free tooling Expo gives away to make its own platform stickier, useful only to developers who already build with Expo.
business_use_cases: A mobile dev shop installs it so every developer's AI assistant follows the same Expo best practices instead of hallucinating deprecated APIs.
An indie app developer uses it to speed up App Store submission chores, like configuring EAS builds, by letting their agent follow the skill instead of reading docs.

money_ideas.idea: Not independently monetizable; a third party could bundle it into a paid 'AI app factory' course as supporting material.

steal_this: There isn't much to steal here — it's vendor infrastructure given away for free; skip building a standalone product on top of it.
